narrative.northStar: The Lacquer Hall & the Điệp Workshop
narrative.overview: REDA is a Vietnamese gallery of Vietnamese painting, built from three native media — sơn mài (lacquer), tranh Đông Hồ (folk woodblock on giấy điệp), and sơn dầu (oil) — rather than any European tradition. Two rooms: a deep sơn-mài dark viewing hall where the lit artwork leads and chrome recedes, and a bright giấy-điệp workshop carrying the folk-print palette where the curator works. One palette, one Vietnamese-first type system, two registers. Warm, hand-made, and material in reference — but rendered flat and clean, with real material texture entering only as scanned assets, never as CSS. This retires the prior Renaissance-Codex identity that read as non-Vietnamese.
keyCharacteristics: Two registers: dark sơn-mài hall (Experience) · light điệp workshop (Operate).
One gold accent; son (red) = action; chàm (indigo) = detail/inspect.
Vietnamese-capable, Vietnamese-first type; the display face performs on Vietnamese letterforms.
Flat color and light — no faked material texture.
The art leads; chrome recedes until called.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: A single gold carries the brand as accent, not area. If gold is filling regions, the register is wrong.

rules.name: The Meaningful Red Rule
rules.body: Son (cinnabar) means action — the enter seal, the primary do-this. If red isn't an action, it shouldn't be red.

rules.name: The Vietnamese Display Rule
rules.body: UTM Dragon Fire renders only large Vietnamese titles. Never English strings, never body, never a section heading.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No mono eyebrow/kicker above a heading. The title carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Flat-Material Rule
rules.body: Never fake a material in CSS. Sơn-mài, giấy điệp, oil canvas, and Đông Hồ prints are scanned assets or nothing; flat color plus light otherwise.

rules.name: The Lit-Room Rule
rules.body: Every shadow carries an offset and a soft blur; depth reads as lighting, not decoration.

rules.name: The Fixed-Pin Rule
rules.body: A hotspot pin never zooms with its artwork. Its screen size is constant across zoom (largest when the whole artwork is in view); only its anchored position tracks the image.

dos: Do keep the two registers honest: dark sơn-mài for experience, light giấy điệp for operate — same accent, same type.
Do reserve UTM Dragon Fire for large Vietnamese titles; set smaller headings in MJ Modern.
Do make son mean action and chàm mean detail/inspect, consistently.
Do prove every layout with real Vietnamese copy at every breakpoint.
Do theme text selection, caret, scrollbar, and focus ring from the palette.
donts: Don't fake material texture in CSS (no paper grain, canvas weave, lacquer noise, or điệp streaks).
Don't put a mono kicker/eyebrow above a heading.
Don't let gold fill regions — it is an accent, not an area.
Don't reach back for the Renaissance/Didone/da-Vinci mood; that identity is retired.
Don't use gradient text, dark colored glows, or thick colored side-borders.
